Sandbox_GSSiK_Addon_Builder_LootPeripher: Chance to find the installable Builder add-on peripheral (GS Digital Whiteboard). 0 = no spawn.
Sandbox_GSSiK_Addon_Builder_LootMagazine: Chance to find the Builder add-on magazine. 0 = no spawn.
Sandbox_GSSiK_Addon_Builder_LootDiskProg: Loot weight: Builder install disk magazine
Chance to find the magazine that teaches how to program the Builder install disk. 0 = no spawn.
Sandbox_GSSiK_Addon_Builder_LootComponen: Chance to find any of the 3 loose Digital Whiteboard parts (Frame, Display Panel, Stylus). 0 = no spawn.
Sandbox_GSSiK_Addon_Builder_DebugMode_to: Enables extra console logging for the Builder add-on only. No gameplay effect.
Sandbox_GSSiK_Addon_Builder_LootInstallD: Multiplier for how often the already-programmed Builder install disk spawns as loot in the world (separate from its blank/programmable counterpart). 1.0 = normal, 0 = never spawns (craft-only).
Sandbox_GSSiK_Addon_Builder_Recipe_White: If ON, this item can be crafted from its recipe. If OFF, the recipe does not exist and Whiteboard Frame can only be found in the world as loot.
If ON, the recipe for Whiteboard Frame must be learned from its own magazine/manual before it can be crafted. If OFF, it is known from the start. Has no effect if the recipe above is disabled.
